subject.title: feat(plugins): add Computer Use provider contract

question: Should OpenClaw standardize this identity-only public Plugin SDK contract now, or should the canonical Computer Use contract also carry the static host-binding metadata required for pre-runtime host permission decisions?
rationale: The code can implement either boundary, but only maintainers can decide the durable external Plugin SDK and host-security contract; the related open proposal encodes a materially broader interpretation.

options.title: Approve the narrow identity contract
options.body: Land the `id` and `label` seam as a generic discovery API, remove the implication that it completes the broader host-metadata request, and retain a separate tracked host-binding design.

options.title: Adopt static host metadata too
options.body: Expand the canonical manifest contract to include the approved pre-runtime platform and permission facts, with explicit security semantics and compatibility tests.

options.title: Defer the public API
options.body: Pause this PR until the Computer Use node-host direction and its required plugin-facing contract are agreed together.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow identity contract
recommendation.body: Land the `id` and `label` seam as a generic discovery API, remove the implication that it completes the broader host-metadata request, and retain a separate tracked host-binding design.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior issue and this branch both originate from the same contract proposal, and the branch explicitly references that design history.
